slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Medium · Graphs
slides.narration: Let's solve Youngest Common Ancestor, a medium graphs problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Nodes have only an `ancestor` pointer; find the deepest common ancestor of two descendants.
Equalise depths, then walk up together.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Nodes have only an ancestor pointer; find the deepest common ancestor of two descendants. Equalise depths, then walk up together.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Bring both descendants to the same depth, then climb together until they meet.
slides.narration: Bring both descendants to the same depth, then climb together until they meet.

slides.heading: Approach
slides.narration: Step by step. First, compute both depths. Second, lift the deeper one. Third, move both up until equal.
